searchText: FYI, Amsterdam Engine API initialized with BAL is now in the main branch of the execution-apis repo: https://github.com/ethereum/execution-apis/pull/691 Credits to <@792404665068158998> This EthResearch thread got brought up during ACDT: https://ethresear.ch/t/ethereum-needs-standards-punk/23151 I feel it is very relevant for here, and or the RPC standardization calls 🙂 Yes it is relevant We have some hive tests for getLogs, and besu is failing them. The other clients are passing though. So I am not yet sure what he means exactly regarding the missing logs. More broadly, https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7919 addresses this point in a way which doesn't rely on trusted bug fixes/ELs, e.g., via incorporating https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7745 or https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7792, https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7708, and https://eips.ethereum.org/EIPS/eip-7799
